source.name: PR Newswire (Humain): NASSR FC Football Club and HUMAIN Announce Landmark Strategic Sponsorship
source.quote: HUMAIN has been named the Club's Official Sponsor for the 2026–2027 season
source.note: Official announcement by the sponsor: 'HUMAIN will serve as the Club's leading jersey sponsor throughout the 2026–2027 season'. Also reported by Arab News (2026-07-28) and Footy Headlines' home-kit reveal (2026-07-30).

source.name: SPORTFIVE (LinkedIn): three-year partnership between Gathern and ALNASSR Saudi Club
source.quote: Gathern will proudly take its place on the upper chest of AlNassr’s jersey across all Saudi Pro League, King’s Cup and Saudi Super Cup matches
source.note: Deal facilitator's announcement of a three-year jersey partnership (2024/25 to 2026/27). LinkedIn shows the post only as '2y' old; the post id decodes to 3 September 2024. Gathern is also visible on the upper chest in the official Saudi Pro League 2026-27 kit photo (spl.com.sa 'Fresh Fit' gallery).

source.name: Breaking Travel News: AROYA Cruises Renews Sponsorship Agreement with Al Nassr FC for the 2026-27 Season
source.quote: AROYA Cruises will continue to feature on Al Nassr FC’s official playing kit throughout the 2026-27 season
source.note: AROYA is on the left sleeve in the official Saudi Pro League 2026-27 kit photo (spl.com.sa 'Fresh Fit' gallery).

summary: Adidas home kit. HUMAIN is the main front sponsor, Gathern sits on the upper chest, AROYA Cruises is on the sleeve; the back of the shirt is plain (product photos on store-alnassr.com). SHG, listed here in pre-season roundups, is not on this shirt.
